Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Company Description Z E N O S is an IT implementation specialist focused on managing complex technology projects from initial analysis through ongoing performance optimization. The team works closely with clients to clarify business situations, understand detailed requirements, and select the most appropriate software solutions. Z E N O S oversees the full implementation lifecycle, including planning, installation, configuration, integration, deployment, and organizational change management. The company places strong emphasis on defining and maintaining performance KPIs, ensuring that systems deliver measurable results over time. Z E N O S approaches every aspect of IT implementation as a serious responsibility and is committed to high professional standards.
 Role Description The System Administrator at Z E N O S is a full-time hybrid role based in Bucharest, Romania, with the flexibility to work from home part of the time. This role is responsible for managing and maintaining servers, networks, and core IT infrastructure to ensure stable and secure operations. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring system performance, applying updates and patches, managing user access and permissions, and performing regular backups and recovery tests. The System Administrator will handle troubleshooting of hardware, software, and network issues, provide technical support to internal users, and collaborate with implementation teams during software deployments. The role also involves documenting configurations and procedures, contributing to IT security practices, and suggesting improvements to system reliability and efficiency.
 Qualifications
Strong System Administration skills, including server management, operating system configuration, and routine maintenance.
Solid Troubleshooting and Technical Support capabilities for diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
Experience with Network Administration, such as managing switches, routers, firewalls, and basic network security practices.
Broad understanding of Information Technology environments, including infrastructure components, virtualization, and cloud services.
Familiarity with backup and recovery tools, monitoring solutions, and patch management processes.
Ability to document procedures clearly and communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
Relevant technical certification (e.g., CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Server+, Microsoft, Cisco) or equivalent practical experience.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
Proactive mindset, attention to detail, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a hybrid setting.
